messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: canary group 'prefetch' observed timeout rate 6.2% (>5% abort). Auto-killchain engaged. Paging @Sam for on-call runbook. https://incidents.redwood/1769876543
Sam: ack — I'm on it.
Sam: quick look at dashboards: timeout spike starts ~12:01 UTC, concentrated on prefetch-worker pool (us-east). Checking canary status now.
Sam: `redwoodctl canary status prefetch --last 15m` output: ```
prefetch-canary: state=unhealthy
timeouts=6.2% (abort threshold=5.0%)
active-version=canary-v2
```
Meera: Sam — customer-facing impact? any hosted-api hits returning 5xx?
Sam: small surface: ~0.6% of global requests 502s in last 10m, mostly us-east. No broad SLA alerts yet but two customers reported errors via support.
Taylor: FYI I rolled `prefetch_v2` flag to 20% at 11:58 for staged canary. Could be related.
Jordan: deploy-bot: Deployed canary-v2 @11:57 by Taylor (release/feature/prefetch-parallel).
Sam: hypothesis: v2 introduces parallel prefetch connections causing upstream timeouts under certain request patterns. Auto-killchain killed canary, but the flag is still on for some traffic.
Meera: can we flip the flag back at canary scope? `ffctl set prefetch_v2 false --scope=canary`
Sam: executing flag toggle now.
Sam: `ffctl set prefetch_v2 false --scope=canary` -> success. Audit shows change pushed.
incident-bot: AUDIT: feature flag change by Sam at 12:06 UTC (prehook=true).
Sam: monitoring metrics after toggle — timeout rate dropping: 6.2% -> 2.0% -> 1.1% in last 4m. 502s falling correspondingly.
Taylor: I'll prepare a rollback PR for canary-v2 binary (revert parallel prefetch). If flag flip doesn't fully stabilize, we roll binary back.
Sam: agreed. If 5xx <0.5% sustained for 5m we'll close. Otherwise perform rollback and cut an emergency patch.
Jordan: ops note: created OPS ticket #OPS-1234 for the two customer reports, routing to support + AE.
Meera: handoff plan — Sam, can you hand to me at 12:20 UTC for continued monitoring and post-incident follow-up?
Sam: handing off to Meera. Runbook notes: toggled prefetch_v2 at 12:06, observed metrics improving, will stay available for rollback steps.
Meera: ack taking over. I'll continue 15m watch and coordinate with Taylor on rollback PR if necessary. Updating incident log and customer messages. :eyes: 
Taylor: will own postmortem and remediation (rate-limits/backpressure + more conservative prefetching).
Sam: closing active page from oncall side, leaving thread for handoff.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — canary killed and canary-scoped flag reverted. Next action: postmortem assigned to Taylor, timeline to be posted in #incidents within 48h.
